q-67547.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14231667/assets/8af022dcc3065a036ba04fb79e75c43906ccef7f32e3416917778afec3d344a8.png)

Given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A)=\frac{7}{3},$ calculate the area (in square units) of $△ABC$ shown above.
q-67547.worked_solution:
In this case, the area of the right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC.
$$

We are given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A)=\frac{7}{3}.$ Notice that relative to $∠A,$ we have expressions for the lengths of the opposite side $\overset{―}{BC}$ and adjacent side $\overset{―}{AC}.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A) & =\frac{BC}{AC} \\ \frac{7}{3} & =\frac{4x-1}{x+1} \\ 7(x+1) & =3(4x-1) \\ 7x+7 & =12x-3 \\ 7x-12x & =-3-7 \\ -5x & =-10 \\ x & =2\end{aligned}
$$

So, the side lengths are

$$
\begin{aligned}AC & =x+1=2+1=3, \\ BC & =4x-1=4(2)-1=7.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 3\cdot 7 \\  & =10.5.\end{aligned}
$$

q-67547.html:
Question 1
?

Given that tan⁡(m∠A)=73, calculate the area (in square units) of △ABC shown above.

a
10.5
b
14
c
11.5
d
21
e
24
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

In this case, the area of the right triangle is A=12AC⋅BC.

We are given that tan⁡(m∠A)=73. Notice that relative to ∠A, we have expressions for the lengths of the opposite side BC― and adjacent side AC―. Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to solve for x:

tan⁡(m∠A)=BCAC73=4x−1x+17(x+1)=3(4x−1)7x+7=12x−37x−12x=−3−7−5x=−10x=2

So, the side lengths are AC=x+1=2+1=3,BC=4x−1=4(2)−1=7.

Therefore, the area of △ABC is A=12AC⋅BC=12⋅3⋅7=10.5.

Given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A)=\frac{9}{8},$ calculate the area (in square units) of $△ABC$ shown above.
q-124430.worked_solution:
In this case, the area of the right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC.
$$

We are given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A)=\frac{9}{8}.$ Notice that relative to $∠A,$ we have expressions for the lengths of the opposite side $\overset{―}{BC}$ and adjacent side $\overset{―}{AC}.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A) & =\frac{BC}{AC} \\ \frac{9}{8} & =\frac{4x-2}{3x+1} \\ 9(3x+1) & =8(4x-2) \\ 27x+9 & =32x-16 \\ 9+16 & =32x-27x \\ 25 & =5x \\ x & =5\end{aligned}
$$

So, the side lengths are

$$
\begin{aligned}BC & =4x-2=4(5)-2=18, \\ AC & =3x+1=3(5)+1=16.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 16\cdot 18 \\  & =144.\end{aligned}
$$

In this case, the area of the right triangle is A=12AC⋅BC.

We are given that tan⁡(m∠A)=98. Notice that relative to ∠A, we have expressions for the lengths of the opposite side BC― and adjacent side AC―. Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to solve for x:

tan⁡(m∠A)=BCAC98=4x−23x+19(3x+1)=8(4x−2)27x+9=32x−169+16=32x−27x25=5xx=5

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14231667/assets/ed4fb3bd21624b15349fd520c2944389d81af99d81962fa54b815628fd7360aa.png)

In square units rounded to one decimal place, the area of $△ABC$ is{{field-1}}.
q-244482.worked_solution:
In this case, the area of the right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BC.
$$

We are given that $m∠B={35}^{∘}.$ Notice that relative to $∠B,$ we have expressions for the lengths of the opposite side $\overset{―}{AC}$ and adjacent side $\overset{―}{BC}.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠B) & =\frac{AC}{BC} \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡({35}^{∘}) & =\frac{x+2}{2x} \\ 2x\cdot \operatorname{tan}⁡({35}^{∘}) & =x+2 \\ 2x\cdot \operatorname{tan}⁡({35}^{∘})-x & =2 \\ x(2\operatorname{tan}⁡({35}^{∘})-1) & =2 \\ x & =\frac{2}{2\operatorname{tan}⁡({35}^{∘})-1} \\ x & =4.994\,8…\end{aligned}
$$

So, the side lengths are 

$$
\begin{aligned}BC & =2x=2(4.994\,8…)=9.989\,6…, \\ AC & =x+2=(4.994\,8…)+2=6.994\,8….\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}(9.989\,6…)(6.994\,8…) \\  & =34.937\,8… \\  & ≈34.9,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to one decimal place.
